$comment: Advisories the dependency gate tolerates, each with a reason and an expiry. Past its date a waiver FAILS the pipeline until the dependency is fixed or the waiver is renewed under review — the same rule feature flags live by. Read by scripts/dependency-audit.mjs.

advisories.reason: Fixed in nodemailer 7.0.11+/10.x; the mailer is on 6.10 and the jump is a major. Both advisories are denial-of-service in the address parser on attacker-supplied addresses; recipients here come from the user directory and the SMTP host is the deployment's own. Scheduled: bump to 10.x with the mailer's own send test.

The `raw` message option bypassing disableFileAccess/disableUrlAccess. The email adapter never passes `raw` and builds every message itself from a rendered template. Same scheduled major bump as above.
Quadratic address parsing on attacker-supplied addresses; see GHSA-rcmh-qjqh-p98v — recipients are directory-sourced. Same scheduled major bump.

Symlink traversal when extracting an untrusted archive. Reached only through puppeteer-core's browser DOWNLOADER, which this deployment never runs: the PDF renderer launches the Chromium at CHROMIUM_PATH and downloads nothing. Fix is puppeteer-core 25 (major); scheduled with a render smoke test.
Arbitrary file write through symlink archive entries — the same unused browser-download path as GHSA-jmr9-qjv8-65gv. Same scheduled major bump.
